g.text: Kirchhoff’s correction adds the stoichiometric heat-capacity difference
Hypothetical reaction with constant ΔC_p over the range and no phase transition. Reaction enthalpy uses products minus reactants at the same temperature.
Temperature-dependent heat capacities should be integrated; latent heats must be included if reference paths cross phase transitions.
